package.description: A slicing software for light-curing 3D printers, independently developed by Creality.

en-US.description: A slicing software for light-curing 3D printers, independently developed by Creality.
en-US.longDescription: Halot Box is a slicing software for light-curing 3D printers, independently developed by Creality. It is an easy-to-operate software that provides various model processing functions for free. It can help you remotely control and monitor your 3D printer, and assist you in printing directly from your computer.
en-US.name: HALOT BOX

zh-CN.description: 更酷的光固化切片软件
zh-CN.longDescription: HALOT BOX 是创想三维自主研发的一款光固化切片软件。它内置了创想云模型库并支持模型的搜索、收藏、分享和导入，也可进行模型和支撑的编辑、自动布局、抽壳、打洞操作，切片后的文件支持本地保存、上传创想云、WiFi 发送到打印机，软件还支持了 14 种语言，未来还将支持更多的实用功能。
